page.title: About
page.description: Cáirde Corrin is a voluntary community group working on the Glenabo and Corrin woodlands near Fermoy, Co. Cork.

hero.title:
A community group
working to a catchment.
hero.intro: Cáirde Corrin is a voluntary group in Fermoy, Co. Cork. We work on the Glenabo and Corrin woodlands and the waterways that run through them.

blocks.heading: Our vision
blocks.text: Glenabo-Corrin is an historical land where all living things can thrive in harmony with nature.

blocks.heading: Our mission
blocks.text: We work to protect, restore and celebrate the environment, heritage and recreational use of our Glenabo-Corrin waterways, engaging with our local community, partnering with agencies, and taking action to ensure the rivers and their valleys flourish for future generations.

items.title: Coillte
items.text: Owner and manager of Glenabo and Corrin woods. All works on their land are subject to their consent and assessment procedures.

items.title: National Biodiversity Data Centre
items.text: Where sightings and survey records are submitted.

items.title: The local authority
items.text: Riverside and roadside sections of the proposed loop route.

blocks.heading: How to get involved
blocks.text: You do not need to be an ecologist. Most of what needs doing is walking, looking, recording and turning up. Get in touch and we will tell you what is happening next.
